description: Eight independent sixteen-step voltage sequencers, each with its own clock, length, advance mode and two controls you configure yourself, with thirty-two stored programs

params.text: Enables every track to take clock pulses; a track set to 'Exclude from RUN' ignores it
Resets every track's sequence and sends a 1ms pulse from the RST output; a track set to 'Exclude from MASTER RST' ignores it
Selects one of the thirty-two programs, 0 to 31; the choice only takes effect when SET is pressed, unless AUTO is on
Applies a program change the moment it is made, instead of waiting for the SET button
Restores the selected program, discarding any unstored changes; with AUTO off it also cancels a program selection and goes back to the state before it
Double-click to store every track and setting into the selected program; it stays lit for about a second to confirm
Sets how many steps that track runs through, 1 to 16
Does whatever that track's U1 knob has been configured to do; right-click it to choose
Does whatever that track's U2 knob has been configured to do; right-click it to choose
Sets the voltage that step sends on that track, over the range chosen under Knobs RANGE

inputs.text: The main clock every track follows unless it has its own clock patched
A trigger or a gate here works the RUN button, depending on the RUN input setting in the global settings
A trigger here resets every track's sequence
Selects the program by voltage, 0-10V, or steps to the next stored one on each trigger with PROG Input type set to Trig
A trigger here does what the RECL button does
That track's own clock, which replaces the main clock for it; in CV advance mode a 0-10V level here addresses the step directly
A trigger here resets that track's sequence
Does whatever that track's U1 input has been configured to do; right-click it to choose
Does whatever that track's U2 input has been configured to do; right-click it to choose

outputs.text: That track's step voltage, scaled by any outscale control set on the track
A 1ms pulse each time a global reset happens

notes: each track's U1 and U2 inputs and knobs do nothing until you configure them: right-click the control, or the track number, or use the general menu, and pick a type.
the input types are IN CHANGE, IN CHANGE PROB, IN LENGTH, IN MODE, IN OUTSCALE, IN RESET STEP#, IN RETRIG, IN REVERSE, IN RUN and IN SKIP PROB.
the knob types are KNOB CHANGE PROBABILITY, KNOB MODE, KNOB OUTSCALE, KNOB RESET STEP#, KNOB RETRIG PROBABILITY, KNOB ATTENUATOR and KNOB ATTENUVERTER.
the advance modes on each track's MOD display are >> forward, << backward, PP ping pong, and |PP| ping pong with the end steps repeated.
the other advance modes are RAND, a random step; RNDr, random only while IN REVERSE is high; and CV, which addresses the step from that track's clock input.
right-clicking a track's number opens that track's own menu, holding its advance mode, its U1 and U2 settings, its track settings, its Track DELAY and its copy, paste and randomise commands.
Track DELAY holds a track's step advance back by up to 5 samples so one track's output can modulate another's input in step; the clock output is never delayed.
menu: Randomize Steps — a submenu with All tracks and Track 1 to Track 8, which sets that track's step knobs to random values
Initialize Steps — a submenu with All tracks and Track 1 to Track 8, which sets that track's step knobs to zero for its range
Knobs RANGE — sets the voltage span every step knob covers
Global DELAY — sets the step-advance delay, 0 to 5 samples, applied to every track that has no delay of its own
GLOBAL settings — a submenu holding Track Defaults, the module settings and the user interface settings
Track Defaults — under GLOBAL settings, sets the '1st clk after reset:' and 'Sequence Reset:' defaults new tracks take
Module Settings — under GLOBAL settings, holds RUN Input, choosing Gate or Trig for the RUN jack, and Reset Seq on PROG change
User Interface — under GLOBAL settings, holds MODE mouse controls, which lets a click on a MOD display step the mode instead of opening a menu
TRACK settings — opens the per-track settings for every track from the module's own menu
PROG Input type: CV, Trig — chooses whether the PROG jack reads a voltage or steps to the next stored program on each trigger
Scan Last Prog — reads every program again and reports the highest one that holds anything
copy/paste — a submenu for copying and pasting a whole panel, the U1 and U2 settings, all eight sequences or one sequence at a time
DISK operations — a submenu with Load preset and Save preset, Import and Export All Sequences, and Import stepSeq seq. to: and Export stepSeq seq. from: for one track at a time
Reset default USER settings — puts every U1 and U2 control back to its default type, behind an 'Are you Sure?' submenu whose only item is RESET!
Erase ALL PROGS — clears every stored program, behind an 'Are you Sure?' submenu whose only item is ERASE!
Tips — a submenu that only prints reminders about configuring the user controls and storing programs
